0022600143.text: The Lakers (3-1, 1-0 on the road) are playing this as their fifth game of the 2026-27 season, have won three of their last four, and sit 1st in the Pacific and 5th in the West, though they're without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain). The LA Clippers (1-2, 1-0 at home) are 3rd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 9th in the West after losing their last two, and they're missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps soreness), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). The Lakers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 125-117 win in Los Angeles on October 23, and the teams split their 2025-26 meetings 2-2.
